h: Peter Obi says insecurity stops him walking freely in Nigeria, unlike in the UK
p: NDC presidential candidate Peter Obi says security warnings prevent him from taking simple walks in Nigeria, recalling how he walked and took trains freely while living in London.
body: NDC presidential candidate Peter Obi has spoken about worsening insecurity in Nigeria, saying safety warnings now stop him from taking simple walks or jogging in his own neighbourhood.

Addressing the Global Peter Obi Supporters Summit in Abuja on Saturday, 21 November 2026, the former Anambra governor recalled living in the UK, on the same street as the Mayor of London. He said they would walk the streets and take the train without security escorts.
He contrasted that with Nigeria today, recalling that he used to walk freely to church in Lagos in the 1980s and 1990s, but said security concerns now prevent him from doing so.
Insecurity is one of the major issues in the 2027 campaign, ahead of the 16 January election.
more: Obi says he cannot walk freely in Nigeria.
He recalled walking and taking trains in London.
He spoke at a supporters' summit in Abuja.
